name: What is the typical lifespan of an exterior paint job?
description: A professional exterior paint job typically lasts 5 to 15 years, depending on paint quality, preparation, and local climate.

mainEntity.name: What is the typical lifespan of an exterior paint job?

acceptedAnswer.text: The longevity of an exterior paint job depends on several factors, including the quality of materials used, surface preparation, application technique, and local climate conditions. Generally, a professional exterior paint job can last between 5 to 15 years. High-quality paints and primers, meticulous surface cleaning, and proper application in optimal weather significantly extend this lifespan. Exposure to harsh sun, extreme temperatures, and persistent moisture can reduce it.
